##### Project general facts
OceaniQ 1 is the flagship villa development by OceaniQ, a two-time Asia Pacific Property Awards winner that has rapidly established itself as one of Bali's most trusted and respected premium developers since its founding. The project presents an exclusive collection of luxury villas ranging from one to four bedrooms, each conceived and crafted to the highest international standards by the award-winning SL Architects bureau, whose celebrated portfolio spans over four hundred completed projects across the globe. OceaniQ's vertically integrated approach to development, backed by full legal compliance including AMDAL and PBG permits within Bali's pink zone, provides investors with a level of security and transparency that is rare in the Indonesian real estate market. The result is a boutique villa community of genuine exclusivity, where world-class design, robust legal foundations, and a prestigious address converge in one extraordinary offering.

OceaniQ 1 provides residents and guests with a curated selection of premium on-site facilities designed to support an effortless, resort-quality lifestyle. The CALMA Coastal Food Space serves as the heart of the community — a beautifully conceived restaurant and café-coworking concept complete with a dedicated children's room with a nanny, perfect for families who value both relaxation and productivity in equal measure. A full concierge service operating around the clock ensures that every need — from transfers and laundry to reservations and storage — is handled with seamless, attentive care. The intimate scale of the development, combined with the richness of its shared spaces, creates a warm and connected community atmosphere that larger resorts can rarely achieve.

The villas of OceaniQ 1 are architectural expressions of understated tropical luxury, designed by SL Architects with the same precision and creative ambition that has earned the bureau international recognition across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Interiors are defined by premium natural materials, generous proportions, and a flowing spatial logic that draws the lush tropical surroundings into every living space. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, high ceilings that fill rooms with warm Balinese light, and elegant detailing — including the signature floating staircases — create interiors that are as beautiful to live in as they are to look at. A rigorous triple waterproofing system, climate-experienced construction teams, and comprehensive structural warranties ensure that this quality endures with complete confidence for years to come.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nusa Dua occupies a position of unrivalled prestige on the Balinese coastline — a purpose-built, gated tourism enclave that has been meticulously designed and maintained to international standards since its inception. The area is blessed with some of the island's finest sandy beaches, offering calm, swimmable waters and gentle entry that attract a sophisticated, high-spending international visitor base year-round. Wide, tree-lined pedestrian avenues, impeccably maintained streets, round-the-clock security, and an almost complete absence of through traffic give the neighbourhood a sense of serenity and privacy that is extraordinarily rare on a popular tourist island. Geger Beach and Nusa Dua Beach — two of Bali's most celebrated stretches of coastline — are a short walk from the development, placing the very best of the island's natural beauty immediately on the doorstep.

The immediate surroundings of Nusa Dua offer a concentration of world-class leisure, dining, and lifestyle amenities that rivals any premium resort destination in Asia. Bali Collection, the island's largest open-air shopping and entertainment complex, lies within moments and brings together boutiques, international dining, cinemas, spa centres, and art galleries in a single beautifully landscaped destination. The Bali National Golf Club — one of Asia's top championship courses — is reachable in minutes, while a superb selection of gourmet restaurants offering oceanfront dining, Italian cuisine, and creative global menus enriches everyday life with extraordinary culinary experiences. Neighbouring properties include The St. Regis, Grand Hyatt, The Mulia, Conrad, and Marriott, confirming that OceaniQ 1 sits within the most prestigious hospitality address on the island.

Nusa Dua represents one of the most structurally sound and rewarding investment locations in all of Southeast Asia, underpinned by a combination of scarcity, demand, and prestige that is impossible to replicate elsewhere on the island. The coastline is now effectively fully developed — no more first-line beachfront land is available in the area — meaning that well-positioned assets here carry an inherent and growing rarity value that drives long-term capital appreciation. The area's sustained premium tourism flow, guaranteed by the presence of globally recognised luxury hotel brands and an exceptionally well-maintained environment, ensures consistently strong rental yields and occupancy for investment-grade properties. For those seeking a Bali asset that combines lifestyle excellence with investment fundamentals of the highest order, this address is simply without equal.
